summary: After a night without internet and a reboot, Samantha comes back by itself once the network is back. Three changes, all inside the existing health manager and gateway memory guard: (1) a Companion with no process is restarted without the idle proof, which only protects work owned by a live Companion; (2) the idle proof no longer reads Remote Bridge receipts written before the current boot; (3) on a new boot the health manager resets its service states to unknown and clears their backoffs.
reason: S24 27/10: after the outage and a reboot the Companion stayed down. The health manager logged state=idle_unproven action=skip_repair every 15 s because gateway-memory-guard.py --idle-proof read all 31 366 Remote Bridge receipts and exceeded its 3 s deadline (measured 3.28 s, reason remote_bridge_scan_partial). There was no Companion process, so nothing could be interrupted. The state files also still said healthy for dead services (sshd, slack_bridge, …) and kept a 15 min companion backoff from the previous boot. Amine decided on 27/10 that nothing restarts while offline; these changes only act once the services are checked again.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-health-deploy-lock.py
tests.evidence: 5 tests. New: a Companion with no process is repaired even when the idle proof fails (fails before the change: idle_unproven, no start). Kept: a live but unhealthy Companion is not replaced without the idle proof; the deploy lock still skips the repair.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-gateway-memory-guard.py
tests.evidence: 20 tests. New: receipts written before the boot (including one claiming a live pid) are not read and do not count; the deadline still yields remote_bridge_scan_partial; a receipt written after the boot by a live instance still counts.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-health-boot-reset.py
tests.evidence: The 27/10 state files (healthy for dead services, companion degraded with failures 6 and a future next) become unknown with failures 0 and next 0 on a new boot; canonical_mode is untouched; a second start on the same boot keeps the states. Fails without the reset call.

tests.name: health suites
tests.evidence: test-health-restart-escalation, test-health-resource-policy, test-health-hysteresis, test-health-verdict, test-health-verdict-f5, test-health-qa-queue pass.

capabilities.reason: Recovery behaviour of existing supervisors only; no capability, route or scope change.

architecture.reason: Same health manager, same idle proof, same state files and lease; no new store, daemon, scheduler or retry engine. Nothing restarts while offline: the existing immune gate still decides supervisor restores.

evidence: Read-only assessment: health supervision scripts only; no MCP schema, adapter or endpoint changed.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
With a live Companion the idle proof still reads every receipt written since the boot; a very long uptime can again exceed the deadline (refusal stays conservative).
Live proof: Wi-Fi cut of 10 minutes then restored, Samantha back without a manual action (with Amine).
